name: UnifiedSearchPanel

states.name: Search Input
states.description: Users need a search input that accepts queries of 2+ characters and returns cross-entity results ranked by relevance.

states.name: Search Results Display
states.description: Users need search results showing entity type, title, snippet, and relevance score, with color-coded icons distinguishing findings (red), fixes (green), knowledge (blue), errors (orange), rules (purple), and workflows (cyan).

states.name: Command Palette Modal
states.description: A global command palette accessible via Cmd+K/Ctrl+K from any page, providing the same search functionality in a modal overlay that can be dismissed with Escape.

states.name: Command Palette Inline Results

requiredElements.text: Type at least 2 characters to search

states.description: Command palette shows inline results with entity icons and click-to-navigate behavior.

states.name: Search Interaction
states.description: Users interact with the search via text input, form submission, and in the command palette via keyboard shortcuts. The search requires minimum 2 characters and the submit button is disabled until met.

states.name: Search Result Rendering
states.description: Search results display entity type icons with color coding, titles, snippet previews (2-line clamp), relevance scores as percentages, and a summary header with counts per entity type.

states.name: Search Navigation
states.description: The unified search is accessible both as a dedicated tab (/unified-search) and as a global command palette (Cmd+K) from any page in the application.

description: Unified Search — searches across all knowledge graph data stores (findings, fixes, knowledge, errors, rules, workflows) and presents ranked results. Available as a dedicated tab and as a global Cmd+K command palette overlay.
